summary: Most frontend narrative sections (Hero/Executive Pitch, About Me, Success Criteria, Impact, 90‑Day Roadmap) and navigation are implemented with a warm amber/orange theme and a collapsible Reference Notes section. However, the Success Criteria module’s required Impact and 90‑Day Roadmap tabs do not appear to expand/show their own content within the module (they scroll instead), and the required success-icons image asset is not evidenced as included/used in the UI.

missing_requirements.requirement: Success Criteria module must have 6 buttons/tabs where the 5th (Impact) and 6th (90‑Day Roadmap Plan) expand/show their views as part of the interactive module (one visible at a time).
missing_requirements.reason: The module renders TabsTriggers for Impact and 90-Day Plan, but they only call scroll handlers to jump to separate page sections; no TabsContent for these tabs is evidenced in the diff snippet, and Impact/Roadmap are implemented as separate sections outside the module (also imported but not evidenced as rendered inside the tab content).

missing_requirements.requirement: Use the minimal line-icon set image for the four success criteria (success-icons.dim_512x512.png) in a cohesive style.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff shows the hero background image being used, but there is no evidence of the required success-icons image being added or referenced anywhere in the rendered UI; success criteria icons appear to be emojis (e.g., '📊', '🛡️') in content.

hallucinated_features.description: Internet Identity authentication plumbing (provider + hooks) and actor management via react-query.
hallucinated_features.reason: The BuildRequest explicitly says authentication is only needed if later required; no requirement asks to add authentication now. The diff adds InternetIdentityProvider, useInternetIdentity, and useActor despite backend having no methods.
No requirement requests toast notifications; the app includes a Toaster component.
